text: right but how did it happen. paint 'technnically' cant open without saving a mesh first, so how does it end up saving to no parts after the fact
resolution: Corrected the incident diagnosis: the first-save Paint gate was not a durability guarantee because editable geometry/ranges and Outliner names were stored separately. A later metadata-less artifact write could replace doc.blob with zero ranges while leaving the 15-row parts.json intact; cold reload then synthesized one whole-mesh range and paired it with Cube 1, and autosave persisted that collapsed one-row projection. Confirmed against Heroin_Bob_head's pre-collapse 15-row metadata, zero-range RJMD header, same-timestamp atlas/painted artifacts, and the old writeModelArtifacts/writeMeshDoc call graph. The already-landed 9d584fd65 prevention separates paint-only persistence from meshdoc writes, requires exact range/row equality at both TS and native boundaries, and forbids part-count shrink without an explicit structural edit capability.
